sections.Profile:
The "Spanish Eyes" pinball machine, produced by Williams in 1972, is a single-player electromechanical game designed by Norm Clark and featuring artwork by John Craig. A distinctive feature of this game is the unusual pop bumper positioned between the flippers, which adds a unique challenge for players. The game incorporates DC-powered jet bumpers, offering fast-paced action and engaging gameplay.
